Lower-wage protection comes instead from sectoral instruments: the Progressive Wage Model (cleaning, security, landscape, retail, etc.) and the Local Qualification Salary floor (~SGD 1,600/month from Jul 2024) that applies only to work-pass holders - neither is a statutory national minimum.

Somalia has NO effective statutory national minimum wage. The 1972 Labour Code mentions minimum wages but sets no amount and is unenforced; the federal government has not legislated one since (ILO NATLEX, Wikipedia 'None', wage-indicator country guides). Private-sector pay is set informally by market/customary arrangements.
